info.title: recoup console API
info.description: Read models over the recoup batch jobs' state. Contract for web/ -- see recoup/api/schemas.py.

schema.title: Response Gate History Api Gate History Get
Response Model Versions Api Model Versions Get
Response Coefficients Api Model Coefficients Get
Response Daily Api Decisions Daily Get

by_mode.title: By Mode
by_mode.description: share of first-retry decisions per bucket, per logging mode

value_usd.title: Value Usd
value_usd.description: schedule value if this bucket goes first

facets.title: Facets
facets.description: counts per value of mode / policy / action over the filtered set

p_success.title: P Success
p_success.description: P(success) of the best schedule's first attempt

delay_hours.title: Delay Hours
delay_hours.description: best first delay, hours since failure

explore_mass.title: Explore Mass
explore_mass.description: probability the logged action is NOT the best bucket

Explanation.title: Explanation
Explanation.description:
The planner's *best* plan for this invoice (no exploration), plus the
Thompson distribution it samples the logged action from. The logged
decision can differ from ``delay_hours`` -- that is exploration.

on_file.title: On File
on_file.description: False when no gate has run yet (treated as HOLD)

queued_retries.title: Queued Retries
queued_retries.description: retries decided and not yet due

explore_share_7d.title: Explore Share 7D
explore_share_7d.description: share of retries decided in the last 7 days that were exploration

recovered_30d.title: Recovered 30D
recovered_30d.description: recovery rate of invoices whose window closed in the last 30 days

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: run the plan job before moving the clock
